intro: I'm Gourav. I build playful, real-time web things — pose memes, traffic sims, walkable portfolios. Lately I'm digging into the infra behind them: GPUs, cloud, MLOps.
howIWork: I start with the fun part — the thing that makes someone say 'wait, that works?' — then figure out the plumbing. Ship small, break things, iterate.
